# Local owner review

Original broad and final affected archives validate; owning checks pass.

Reviewed the single production path against merged source and its simplifier
caller. Decoded minima are necessary lengths. Fixed proofs distinguish quoted
literals from questions and stop before a token crosses the raw allowance.
Trailing escapes have no matching value. Literal proof width uses a bounded raw
scan before checked retry-product division. Unknown retains records; ordinary
matching has no new limit. Only shared explicit fields prove disjointness.

No configuration, shared-glob, layout, allocation, retained pointer, callback,
X/update/barrier or module owner changes. Full initialized comparisons and
removal/default restoration cover normal/reference/collision streams. Independent
legacy witnesses check symmetry and no false-negative proofs. Fixed/member
languages have complete finite-domain checks. Budget controls retain unknown
and ordinary long-pattern matching.

Initial baseline helper misuse and two invalid test examples were corrected
before final focused passes. Failed receipts remain. Review retains the existing both-literal fast path to avoid redundant decoded
work. Its corrected source includes the test assertion line wrap. Four owning
checks/profile, final stages/default-X/clients and scoped sanitizer qualify
that source separately; unaffected EWMH/generic geometry stay with the original
broad source. No second full matrix is run. No universal elapsed
or allocation reduction claim. Maintainer review is separate; no agent merge.
